capabilities: apply Mica, Mica Alt, or Acrylic background materials on Windows
set macOS vibrancy types such as sidebar, window, or under-window
open plugin settings from the ribbon icon or command palette
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS snippet tool; it changes the window background material through Electron APIs, not note styling.
extras: On Windows it requires Window frame style set to Hidden/Obsidian frame; on macOS it requires the Translucent window setting enabled.
intentEvidence: adds is-translucent class to body, mirroring Obsidian's behavior when Translucent window option is enabled on macOS
problem: Obsidian's built-in Translucent window option only works as intended on macOS, so Windows users lack native translucency effects.
summary: Window-effect plugin that applies native translucent backgrounds (Mica, Mica Alt, Acrylic, macOS vibrancy) to the Obsidian window.
